// diagnostic

E0381

A `marker` or `effect` declaration is a retired spelling of a type.

What

A `marker` or `effect` declaration is a retired spelling of a type.

Why

A marker or an effect is a struct or enum: a marker's `impl Marker { … }` block gives its settings, its group or its `fn expand(self, target: Target)` template, and an effect's `impl Effect { … }` block says whether its work can be rolled back.

Fix

Write `struct Name { impl Marker { sites :: [.Function] } }` or `struct Name { impl Effect {} }`; `jet fix` rewrites the declaration.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0381: tests/ui/effects/effect_word_redeclaring_a_prelude_effect_is_retired.stderr.

Error [jet.RetiredDeclarationWord]: `effect Log` re-declares a Prelude effect
  --> tests/ui/effects/effect_word_redeclaring_a_prelude_effect_is_retired.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | effect Log
    | ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The Prelude declares `Log` as a type implementing `Effect`, so every program already names it
 Fix: Delete this declaration; `jet fix` removes it
